title: The Dow Market Happenings For Tuesday, December 4, 2018
text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Tuesday, December 4, 4th, American Express (AXP), Merck (MRK), Pfizer (PFE), UnitedHealth (UNH) and Walgreens (WBA). There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.

Monday the Dow was up +287.97 (+1.13%) at 25,826.43.

There were 22 Dow stocks up Monday.
The Dow stock winners Monday were led by Boeing (BA) +3.81%, Nike (NKE) +3.75% and Apple (AAPL) +3.49%.
The Dow stock losers Monday were led by Verizon (VZ) -3.55%, McDonald’s (MCD) -1.67% and Coca Cola (KO) -1.41%.
Apple (AAPL +3.49%) was downgraded to ‘Hold’ from ‘Buy’ at HSBC.
European stocks are lower and Asian markets ended mostly 1.2 cents at $2.447
